settings.name: STRICT_TRANSPORT_SECURITY
settings.description: **HSTS:** Enforces secure HTTPS connections, reducing risks of man-in-the-middle attacks.

settings.name: CONTENT_SECURITY_POLICY
settings.description: **CSP:** Restricts resource loading to trusted sources, mitigating cross-site scripting and data injection attacks.

settings.name: CONTENT_SECURITY_POLICY_REPORT_ONLY
settings.description: **CSP Report Mode:** Reports violations without blocking content, helping in testing security policies while capturing logs.

settings.name: X_FRAME_OPTIONS
settings.description: **X-Frame-Options:** Prevents clickjacking by controlling whether your site can be framed. Allowed values: `DENY`, `SAMEORIGIN`; an empty value removes this header.

settings.name: X_CONTENT_TYPE_OPTIONS
settings.description: **X-Content-Type-Options:** Prevents browsers from MIME-sniffing, protecting against drive-by download attacks. Allowed values: `nosniff`; an empty value removes this header.

settings.name: X_DNS_PREFETCH_CONTROL
settings.description: **X-DNS-Prefetch-Control:** Regulates DNS prefetching to reduce unintentional network requests and enhance privacy. Allowed values: `on`, `off`.

settings.name: REFERRER_POLICY
settings.description: **Referrer Policy:** Controls the amount of referrer information sent, safeguarding user privacy.

settings.name: PERMISSIONS_POLICY
settings.description: **Permissions Policy:** Restricts browser feature access, reducing potential attack vectors.

settings.name: KEEP_UPSTREAM_HEADERS
settings.description: **Keep Headers:** Preserves selected upstream headers, aiding legacy integration while maintaining security.

settings.name: COOKIE_FLAGS
settings.description: **Cookie Flags:** Automatically adds security flags such as HttpOnly and SameSite, protecting cookies from client-side script access and CSRF attacks.

settings.name: COOKIE_AUTO_SECURE_FLAG
settings.description: **Auto Secure Flag:** Ensures cookies are only sent over secure HTTPS connections by appending the Secure flag automatically.

settings.name: CUSTOM_HEADER
settings.description: **Custom Header:** Provides a means to add user-defined headers in the format HeaderName: HeaderValue for specialized security or performance enhancements.

settings.name: REMOVE_HEADERS
settings.default: Server Expect-CT X-Powered-By X-AspNet-Version X-AspNetMvc-Version Public-Key-Pins
settings.description: **Remove Headers:** Specifies headers to remove, decreasing the chance of exposing internal server details and known vulnerabilities.
